backfill.name: Backfill history
backfill.description: Fetches hourly usage and daily cost from Aurora+ for a past date range and imports it into long-term statistics (Energy dashboard). Runs in the background; a persistent notification appears when it finishes.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Earliest day to fetch. Aurora+ holds roughly 3 years of history.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day to fetch. Defaults to yesterday.

reauth_confirm.description: The Aurora+ integration needs to re-authenticate your account
reauth_confirm.title: Re-authentication needed

user.description: Go to [this page](https://shtrom.github.io/AuroraPlus/), or follow [these instructions](https://github.com/shtrom/AuroraPlus/tree/oauth-mfa-token?tab=readme-ov-file#obtain-a-token) to obtain a full JSON token.
